verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agentic-commerce product-data API, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it supports machine payments, and the axis applies. The only related evidence shows agents can pay Channel3 itself through MPP for its own API (channel3-docs-18). That is a different capability: nothing shows developers can put HTTP 402 per-call payments on their own API or service. The developer monetization Channel3 does document is affiliate revenue share on product sales (channel3-docs-4), which is not pay-per-call machine payments.
